gloss: to force a sale on; to palm off; to foist on

definitions.gloss: to force a sale on someone; to palm off; to foist on
definitions.explanation: To pressure someone into buying something, often something overpriced, unneeded, or of poor quality. The buyer is marked with に and the goods with を.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{壺|つぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りつける。
examples.english: to foist an expensive vase on someone

examples.japanese: ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りつけた。
examples.english: They palmed off unnecessary goods on an elderly person.

examples.japanese: {言葉巧|ことばたく}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧な⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りつける⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some dealers smooth-talk customers into buying expensive insurance.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). The buyer is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ and the goods with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Compound of ⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to sell) + ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧.

USAGE:
Carries a negative nuance — it implies a pushy, one-sided sale of something the buyer did not really want.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無理|むり}やり→無理やり：10526_muriyari⟧{売|う}りつける: to force a sale on someone
- ⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{売|う}りつける: to palm off at an inflated price
